How It Works

An intelligence layer, not a new platform.

Step 01

Toven reads what your desk already runs on

  • Email, chat, and voice; surveillance alerts; research reports — every queue your team reviews today
  • Connects to your existing archiving and surveillance systems — no migration, no new platform to learn
  • Full coverage from day one, inside the tools your analysts already use
Step 02

AI agents do the first pass on every item

  • Each alert, report, and question gets an agent that assembles context and evaluates the signals
  • Every check cites the rule it ran against — documented automatically
  • The obvious cases clear themselves: ~70% of false positives auto-dispositioned, with full reasoning recorded
Step 03

Your analysts judge what actually needs judgment

  • Only cases warranting human review escalate — with the investigation package pre-built
  • Every disposition lands in the audit trail: cited, timestamped, defensible
  • When a regulator asks why something was approved, the answer takes seconds, not hours
Security

Enterprise-grade security by default

Runs on our cloud — containerized on AWS — or fully on-prem for firms with strict data residency requirements. Your data stays yours: never used to train models, isolated per firm, and encrypted everywhere it moves or rests.

No model trainingClient data never trains models
